dimensions.N: All eligible section cells; every eligible cell participates in fitting
dimensions.M: All MIC/AST/OGC cells selected after correction; no thinning

ordering.model_cells: MIC, AST, OGC blocks; increasing raw source row within each block

centering.mean: mu[s,t,g] = sum(L[g,i] for i in I[s,t]) / len(I[s,t])
centering.population: actual modeled cells after selection, separately per section and cell type

required_files.response.h5: Explicit axes, metadata, corrected counts, uncentered and centered responses, means, coordinates.
required_files.fit.rds: Complete fitted SCT state with effective arguments, realized fitting cells and gene availability.
required_files.execution.json: Exact command, code/config/input/environment identities, effective fit settings, RNG/threads, timings, warnings and exit status.
required_files.validation.json: Measured invariants and numeric residuals, explicit tolerances, pass/fail and artifact readback evidence.

/axes/genes300/raw_gene_index.meaning: Zero-based positions in authenticated raw gene axis

/axes/genes91/raw_gene_index.meaning: Zero-based positions in authenticated raw gene axis

/axes/cells_model/all_cell_index.meaning: Zero-based positions in cells_all, cross-checked by original IDs and source rows

/axes/genes91/all_gene_index.meaning: Zero-based positions in genes300, cross-checked by gene IDs

/all/corrected_counts.meaning: Finite, nonnegative, integer-valued corrected counts at depth 124

/model/centered_response.meaning: Final immutable Y; identical downstream GPINIT and BSFM input

/centering/means.meaning: Arithmetic means over actual modeled cells by section/type/gene

/centering/group_sizes.meaning: Actual modeled cells per type; positive for each of the three types

/metadata/all/sample.meaning: Decoded raw obs/sample preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/gen_fine.meaning: Decoded raw obs/gen_fine preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/gen.meaning: Decoded raw obs/gen preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/gen_coarse.meaning: Decoded raw obs/gen_coarse preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/cluster_coarse.meaning: Decoded raw obs/cluster_coarse preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/coarse_batch.meaning: Decoded raw obs/coarse_batch preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/region_labels.meaning: Decoded raw obs/region_labels preserved without rewriting

/metadata/all/region_labels_coarse.meaning: Decoded raw obs/region_labels_coarse preserved without rewriting

storage.compression: lossless_only; physical chunking left to implementation
storage.strings: UTF-8, original values, no case or whitespace normalization
storage.axis_hash: SHA-256 over uint64-LE byte length plus UTF-8 identifier bytes in order
storage.numeric_hash: SHA-256 over little-endian declared-dtype values in logical C order; dataset shape and axis hashes recorded separately

required_invariants: source, panel, registry, environment and code identities match frozen run specification
all-cell and model axes are unique, complete and ordered as specified
cell IDs and raw source rows resolve to the same source records
each matrix axis explicitly references the matching identity dataset and ordered hash
actual fitting cell IDs equal all eligible section cell IDs
effective method is glmGamPoi_offset without fallback
all required 300 output genes are present; gene estimation/availability recorded; no silent fill
corrected counts finite, nonnegative and integer-valued
selected response and coordinates equal identity-based all-cell subsets
means computed once from actual model population; no variance scaling
Y plus saved group means reconstructs selected response within explicit float64 tolerance
group mean residuals pass documented tolerance; actual residuals retained
coordinate values and source column order unchanged
stack imbalance is fatal; no warning suppression
all output files closed and reopened for readback before completion
validation.numeric_tolerances: Must be explicit in frozen runner configuration and validation report before execution; not silently supplied by a consumer

completion.temporary_directory: unique attempt directory on destination filesystem
completion.final_manifest: written only after closed-file readback validation and hashes pass
completion.promotion: same-filesystem directory rename to previously absent immutable destination
completion.success: final destination plus complete manifest plus validated matching hashes
completion.resume: reuse only closed validated stages with identical input/code/config/environment/dependency identities; otherwise new attempt
completion.run_complete: all 19 section manifests valid and consistent with one run specification
